pr_title: Use staging-csi to work around quay.io availability

issue_context.title: [Failing Test] Storage tests are failing due to quay.io being down
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting reports about continuously failing tests or jobs in Kubernetes CI -->

**Which jobs are failing**:

`skew-cluster-latest-kubectl-stable1-gce`
`gce-cos-master-default`
`gce-cos-master-alpha-features`
`gci-gce-ingress`
`gce-cos-master-reboot`
`gce-cos-master-scalability-100`
`Conformance - GCE - Master`
`integration-master`
`kind-master-parallel`
`kind-ipv6-master-parallel`

**Which test(s) are failing**:

All relying on volume snapshot controller.

**Since when has it been failing**:

`5/18/20 12:38 AM PT`

**Testgrid link**:

https://testgrid.k8s.io/sig-release-master-blocking

**Reason for failure**:

https://quay.io/ is experiencing downtime, causing failure to pull image in volume snapshot controller deployment: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/6a0e01880ad7ea4c110040c3be417516c0bf6bca/cluster/addons/volumesnapshots/volume-snapshot-controller/volume-snapshot-controller-deployment.yaml#L26

/cc @kubernetes/ci-signal
/milestone v1.19
/priority critical-urgent
/sig testing
/sig storage
